summary.headline: The Tricentennial Committee advanced plans for the 2027 anniversary, signing a drone show contract and reviewing event budgets and fundraising.
summary.summary: The Tricentennial Committee met to coordinate multiple projects celebrating Southborough's upcoming 300th anniversary in 2027. Members reviewed progress on a New Year's Day drone light show, confirmed an antique fire engine muster, and discussed expanding Summer Nights into a large music festival. The committee also received an update on the commemorative brick sales campaign and evaluated the route and format for future town parades.

topics.title: Historical music research for 2027 celebrations
topics.summary: Guest researcher Juliana Perez presented preliminary findings on historic Southborough music, composers, and performers, including ties to Fay School and regional glee clubs. She is working to locate original sheet music from town history to organize a historic chamber music performance for the 300th anniversary. Committee members offered resources including the Southborough Historical Commission, local historians, and town records.
key_details: Perez shared research on historic figures including Sarah Shattuck Prentice and former Fay School headmasters.
Goal is to recover authentic local sheet music to stage a period-style chamber music performance.
The committee recommended contacting the interim town clerk, former town clerk Jim Hegarty, and local historian Sally Waters.
topics.outcome: Perez will draft an information request for the committee to circulate via town media.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The committee reviewed, corrected, and approved meeting minutes from previous sessions.
key_details: Approved August 12, 2024 meeting minutes as amended.
Approved September 16, 2024 meeting minutes as amended.
topics.outcome: Both sets of meeting minutes were approved by roll call vote.

topics.title: Utility pole banners and History in Bloom daffodil planting
topics.summary: The chair reported on ongoing coordination with utility companies to install celebratory banners on utility poles. The committee also discussed partnering with the Southborough Gardeners to plant over 100 daffodil bulbs in town center locations for spring blooming.
key_details: Banner locations have been reduced from 87 to 67 poles, with a goal of capping at 50 poles to avoid additional utility inspection fees.
Southborough Gardeners have more than 100 daffodil bulbs ready to plant.
Town staff and the Department of Public Works are reviewing planting locations near the Town House flagpole to avoid interference with landscaping and protect bulbs from squirrels.
topics.outcome: Town administration is continuing paperwork with utilities, and DPW staff will advise on planting sites.

topics.title: Summer Nights 2027 music festival planning
topics.summary: The committee discussed expanding the annual Summer Nights event into a large-scale music festival on Saturday, August 21, 2027. Plans include multiple stages, an afternoon start, food trucks, and a variety of musical genres featuring performers with town connections.
key_details: Target date set for Saturday, August 21, 2027, at the Neary School grounds.
Organizers are finalizing an agreement with a headlining act and planning an afternoon contra dance.
A grant application is being submitted to fund accessibility features including a hospitality tent and shuttle services.
topics.outcome: Organizers are finalizing stage specifications and will coordinate layout with police, fire, and recreation departments.

topics.title: Voices from the Grave and History Makers projects
topics.summary: Working group members shared brief status reports on cemetery history programming and the launch of the History Makers initiative.
key_details: Committee members plan to observe a cemetery tour in Worcester to help design Southborough's Voices from the Grave event.
The History Makers nomination form launched online to recognize notable current and former Southborough residents.
Nominations cover contributions in science, civics, volunteering, business, and other fields.
topics.outcome: Members will promote History Makers nomination forms through town channels.

topics.title: First Night and First Day 2027: drone show and winter activities
topics.summary: The committee reviewed plans for New Year's Day celebrations kicking off the tricentennial year on January 1, 2027. A contract has been executed for a 200-drone light show, while logistical challenges prompted reevaluating a proposed community bonfire and horse-drawn hayrides.
key_details: A contract was signed with vendor Firefly for a 15-minute, 200-drone show at 5:00 PM on January 1, 2027.
Drones will launch from St. Mark's field with viewing designated at Woodward School and Town House parking lots.
The drone show will include 20 visual formations, including two winning student art designs from Trottier Middle School due November 17.
A traditional horse-drawn hay wagon quote exceeded $5,000, prompting the committee to consider tractor wagons instead.
Concerns regarding field damage and underground wiring at Woodward School may push the bonfire to a separate January date at Finn School.
topics.outcome: Staff and committee leaders will conduct a site walk on Friday to inspect potential bonfire locations and refine event timing.
topics.why_it_matters: This major community kickoff event will establish town celebration activities and requires logistical coordination across schools, public safety, and public property.

topics.title: Antique Fireman's Muster
topics.summary: Organizers reported on preparations for an antique hand tub pumping muster scheduled for 2027. Eight antique fire pumping apparatus teams have confirmed participation, with expectations of 16 to 20 teams competing.
key_details: Southborough's two historic hand tubs are currently undergoing restoration for competition.
Sirloin Catering food truck and two live music acts have been booked.
The muster working group confirmed its allocated budget is $25,000, not $35,000.
A field layout map will be presented at the November meeting.
topics.outcome: Organizers will prepare site and parking layouts for the next committee meeting.

topics.title: Town incorporation ceremony and commemorative brick fundraiser
topics.summary: The committee discussed a draft framework for the official Town Incorporation Day ceremony and received a status report on commemorative brick sales for the Old Burial Ground walkway.
key_details: Postcards promoting brick sales were mailed to 3,847 households, and additional cards are being placed in public facilities.
Brick orders will be finalized in mid-November for manufacturing over the winter and installation in early spring.
A 3-page draft outline for Incorporation Day will be reviewed with the town administrator before presentation to the Select Board.
The committee plans to deliver a formal update to the Select Board on December 3, 2024.
topics.outcome: Committee leaders will meet with the town administrator after Special Town Meeting to review ceremony plans.

topics.title: Heritage Day recap and future parade planning
topics.summary: Members debriefed the recent Heritage Day parade and evaluated options to increase spectator attendance for future parades. The committee noted that the 2025 parade will move to Sunday afternoon due to the Jewish holiday calendar, and discussed options for managing the parade route and staging areas.
key_details: The 2025 Heritage Day parade is scheduled for Sunday afternoon, October 12, 2025, to respect Yom Kippur.
Members discussed concerns that past parades had more participants marching than spectators watching.
Options explored include staging cannons at Sharp Field, adjusting parade length, and securing college marching bands.
topics.outcome: The parade working group will review route options and coordinate with public safety officials.

summary.caveats: The video recording title labels the meeting date as 10/14/26; however, internal meeting discussions confirm it took place on Wednesday, October 16, 2024, immediately following Heritage Day and ahead of the October 19, 2024 Special Town Meeting.
